title: Luxuriantly Molten Jamaican Shrimp Curry
description: A rich and earthy Jamaican curry featuring shrimp paste and fermented jang, cooked to perfection on a salt block. This dish is ayurvedic sattvic friendly and perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil on the salt block over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder, salt, and black pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp paste and fermented jang and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, until pink and fully cooked, about 5 minutes.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the curry cool slightly before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Reheat the curry gently before serving if it has cooled too much.
